csv_scope_of_work: Oklahoma Military Department (OMD) is issuing a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) for full renovations to three buildings (Building 3503, Building 3515, and Building 3535) and the construction of a new Sensitive Compartment Information Facility (SCIF) on OMD s headquarters campus in Oklahoma City,Ok. Building 3503 includes approximately 10,818 gross square-feet. Building 3515 includes approximately 13,198 gross square-feet. Building 3535 includes approximately 49,358 gross square-feet. The new SCIF will be approximately 2,777 SF. The OMD Complex Revitalization will have an initial Contract Cost Limitation of approximately $35 million with the opportunity for increased funding if required as a result activities of Phase I in Post-Award. Project award is anticipated to be October 2026. The project scope will require the team to plan, design, phase, and construct all aspects of the OMD Complex Revitalization, including the construction of a SCIF. Options will include FFE, telecom and AV systems. The prioritized phased approach includes Building 3535 as the highest priority.
